ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the circumcircle $O$ of $\triangle ABC$ has a radius of $2\text{cm}$. If $BC=2\text{cm}$, what is the measure of $\angle A$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect OB and OC,\\
since the radius of circle O is 2cm, and BC=2cm,\\
therefore OB=OC=BC,\\
thus, $\triangle$OBC is an equilateral triangle,\\
therefore, $\angle$BOC=60$^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle$A=$\frac{1}{2}\angle$BOC=30$^\circ$,\\
hence, the answer is: $\boxed{30^\circ}$.
